title: Do We Still Need Humans in the Loop? Comparing Human and LLM Annotation in Active Learning for Hostility Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM and human annotation boundaries for detecting anti-immigrant hostility in German political TikTok comments, specifically analyzing systematic false positive and false negative asymmetries.

Analyzing topically clustered annotation disagreements to evaluate whether the LLM systematically conflates right-leaning political critique of immigration policy (e.g., border control demands) with group-directed hostility.
Examining human-LLM annotation disparities specifically within the 'Islam & Islamization' topic cluster to identify if the model broadly conflates anti-Muslim hostility with anti-immigrant hostility.
